type.description: The content type of the object.

parentId.description: ID of the parent content, or null if there is no parent content.

position.description: Position of the folder within the given parent page tree.

authorId.description: The account ID of the user who created this folder.

ownerId.description: The account ID of the user who owns this folder.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the folder was created. In format "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ".

spaceId.description: ID of the space the folder is in.
